title: Projecting reflectors.
officialText: Lighting reflectors may project beyond the top or face of all signs provided that every part of such reflector is at least 10 feet (3048 mm) above the ground or sidewalk level. Reflectors shall be constructed, attached, and maintained so that they shall not be, or become, a hazard to the public.
